summary: iter351 security-audit fixes fully verified. Backend: 25/25 passing (backend/tests/test_iter351_security_audit.py). SEC-001: kiosk lookup returns only {id,name,role,photo_url,location_id,children[]}, no PII keys; 9-digit suffix now 404s; <6 chars 400s; per-IP throttle kicks in at 15th call in 10 min; per-IP isolation confirmed. SEC-003: /api/kiosk/unlock returns identical {"detail":"Invalid credentials"} 401 for unknown identifier, wrong password, random PIN; missing both still 400; valid PIN unlock still works (admin PIN roundtrip); throttle kicks in at 8th failed attempt. SEC-002: admin can still read sc_140b496b (bogus id 404s); a Director scoped only to a freshly-created campus B gets 404 on GET, /report, PUT, POST /notes, POST /payments, POST /sponsor-story and DELETE for the campus-A case, and still reads a case in their own campus B (case B seeded directly in DB to bypass require_staff subject checks). School-portal login throttles at ~10th bogus call. CORS: preflight to /api/kiosk/unlock returns access-control-allow-origin only for https://multi-tenant-scope.preview.emergentagent.com; https://evil.example.com receives no ACAO header. Regression: iter350 badge-less checkpoint scan via /api/security/checkpoint/scan {scan_type:manual,payload:<phone>} still returns badgeless=true, matched_by=phone. Frontend: /kiosk 'ID Check-In' with +256772123456 renders kiosk-found-member with 'Admin' + role 'admin' on separate lines (no stray '·'), no phone/email/PII in the DOM, 'Confirm Check-In' produces 'Admin checked in!' toast. /social-work → open Test Child case → Overview shows cd-support-needed + cd-support-given chips (School fees + Food, Medical toggled), cd-sponsor-story-panel + cd-sponsor-story-generate + cd-sponsor-story-save present, Download Profile Report button present. Zero console errors and zero CORS errors on /login, /dashboard, /kiosk and /social-work.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/events.py::kiosk_unlock — the PIN branch falls back to db.members.find_one({pin: pin}) which returns raw member docs; the current PRIVILEGED_ROLES check catches non-privileged members, but a member with role='Manager' inside db.members (not users) would still unlock. Consider restricting the PIN lookup to db.users only, or double-checking the found id is a real user_id.

backend/routers/social_work.py::school_portal_login returns 404 'Unknown school portal' when the token is wrong and 401 when the password is wrong — that is still a small oracle. Consider collapsing both to a single 401 like kiosk_unlock now does.

backend/deps.py::enforce_public_rate_limit inserts a hit row even when the request is otherwise going to 200; that is fine, but it also swallows all DB errors and logs a warning, meaning a broken Mongo silently disables the limiter. Fail-closed (raise) is safer for security throttles.

backend/routers/social_work.py::_scoped_case_or_404 correctly plugs the by-id read path, but /cases/{id}/notes GET, /cases/{id}/payments GET, /cases/{id}/documents, /cases/{id}/reviews and /cases/{id}/sponsor-story GET need auditing — they may still look up by id alone and leak subordinate rows to a wrong-campus director.
backend/routers/events.py — the file is 2811 lines; the kiosk section is a good candidate to split into routers/kiosk.py with its own tests.
test_credentials: admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Temporary campus-B director is created & torn down inside the test fixture; no residual accounts remain (verified — locations.count TEST_==0, users.count test.director==0).
seed_data_creation: Ensured admin user's phone is +256772123456 so kiosk lookup has an exact-match target (same as iter233). Test fixture creates one TEST_Campus_B_<random> location, one Director user in campus B, and one sc_TEST_<random> case (all cleaned up on fixture teardown). Rate-limit rows in db.public_endpoint_hits are cleared per-test via a small helper. Set/unset admin.pin for the valid-unlock test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: backend/tests/test_iter351_security_audit.py — runs in ~1.5s. It clears db.public_endpoint_hits between throttle tests, so you don't need to wait out the 10-minute window. The SocialWorkCampusScoping class inserts a case B directly into db.social_cases because /api/social-work/cases requires a real child/member subject; if the seed changes so that require_staff/create_case can be exercised with a subject, switch the test to the API path. The Case Detail modal is opened by clicking the case row's subject_name text.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four audit fixes verified working. Only code-review notes above (see critical_code_review_comments): (1) kiosk_unlock PIN branch could still fall through to db.members; (2) school_portal_login still leaks token-vs-password via 404 vs 401; (3) enforce_public_rate_limit fails-open on DB errors; (4) other social-work by-id sub-routes may still need the _scoped_case_or_404 helper.
